description: Get details for a specific vehicle booking by its Gondola booking ID. Returns vendor, pickup/dropoff locations and times, vehicle class, rate, and status. Use when a user asks about a rental they've already booked (e.g. "what time is my pickup?", "where do I pick up my Hertz rental?").

booking_id.description: The Gondola booking ID, as shown by get_upcoming_trips or get_past_trips. Not a rental confirmation number from the vendor.

name: get_vehicle_booking
